role: iMessage bridge via iPhone Shortcuts + Pushcut automation server
capabilities: Send iMessages from your actual phone number via Pushcut webhook → Shortcut
Receive inbound iMessages via Shortcuts automation → HERMES webhook
Fallback to Twilio SMS if Pushcut is unreachable
Message queue with retry for when phone is asleep/offline

architecture.outbound: HERMES → Pushcut webhook → Apple Shortcut → Messages.app → iMessage/SMS
architecture.inbound: Messages.app → Shortcuts automation → HERMES webhook → DB → Unified Inbox

setup: 2. Enable Pushcut Automation Server (runs in background)
3. Create Pushcut webhook actions for send-message
5. Set up Shortcuts automation for inbound messages
6. Set PUSHCUT_API_KEY and PUSHCUT_DEVICE_NAME in env
